meta.name: fsd-generator
meta.description: Generate comprehensive Functional Specification Documents (FSDs) that translate PRD requirements into implementation-ready specifications. Use when the user needs to create an FSD, functional spec, system specification, or detailed feature specification. Triggers on requests like "create an FSD", "write functional specifications", "translate this PRD into specs", or any request to define system behaviors, data requirements, business rules, and acceptance criteria from a PRD or feature description.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。
